service: wage-fairness-api

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: python3.9
  region: ap-southeast-2
  
  environment:
    DB_HOST: fairwageaustralia.ct08osmucf2b.ap-southeast-2.rds.amazonaws.com
    DB_PORT: 3306
    DB_USER: admin
    DB_NAME: fairwageaustralia
    DB_PASSWORD: "fairwageaustralia"
    
    MAX_REQUEST_SIZE: 1048576  
    MAX_CONVERSATION_LENGTH: 100  

package:
  exclude:
    - test.py
    - test2.py

functions:
  calculate:
    handler: handler.lambda_handler
    events:
      - http:
          path: fairness/calculate
          method: post
          cors: true
 
  gender-gap:
    handler: gender_gap_handler.calculate_gender_gap
    events:
      - http:
          path: gender-gap/calculate
          method: post
          cors: true
         
  suburb-score:
    handler: suburb_scoring_handler.score_suburb
    events:
      - http:
          path: suburb/score
          method: post
          cors: true
         
  ai-chat:
    handler: AI_chat.lambda_handler
    environment:
      ZHIPU_API_KEY: "9405476aa25d42a580409da4546dba36.TStXLwwhiycqtLeP"
    events:
      - http:
          path: ai/chat
          method: post
          cors: true
    timeout: 29

  # Forecast endpoints
  forecast-predict:
    handler: forecast.forecast_handler
    events:
      - http:
          path: forecast/predict
          method: post
          cors: true
    timeout: 29
    description: Generate wage forecast for single demographic group

  forecast-compare:
    handler: forecast.compare_handler
    events:
      - http:
          path: forecast/compare
          method: post
          cors: true
    timeout: 29
    description: Compare wage forecasts between two demographic groups

# ============================================
# 部署说明
# ============================================
# 1. 将 YOUR_DB_PASSWORD_HERE 替换为真实的数据库密码
# 2. 将 YOUR_ZHIPU_API_KEY_HERE 替换为真实的智谱 API Key
# 3. 确保这个文件不要提交到 Git！添加到 .gitignore
# 4. 部署命令：serverless deploy
